title: Crash when opening config screen
body:
Minecraft version: 1.21.1
Mod version: 2.1.0

When I try to open the config screen via ModMenu, the game crashes immediately.

Crash report:
```
java.lang.NullPointerException: Cannot invoke "net.minecraft.client.gui.GuiGraphics.pose()"
    at com.example.guitween.config.GuiTweenConfigScreen.init(GuiTweenConfigScreen.java:32)
    at net.minecraft.client.gui.screens.Screen.init(Screen.java:89)
```

Mods installed:
- GUITween 2.1.0
- Fabric API 0.95.0
- ModMenu 9.0.0

Steps to reproduce:
1. Launch game
2. Go to ModMenu
3. Click on GUITween config button
4. Game crashes

Is there a fix for this?
